text: Early Summer in Spokane Washington there are Three granny smith apple trees: 1 is sickly slow growing with drooping leaves and yellowing lower leaves, 1 has slight yellowing and slightly reduced growth, and 1 is growing totally fine. Irrigation is fine. No visible pests. There is rosemary planted at the base of each one. The rosemary by the first tree, the most sickly one, is slow growing too. Sun is the same for each. We have minimal man-hours to work on this issue.
